text: SPLRD[p,q,n,nb] denotes the perpendicular component in the lightcone decomposition of the scalar product p \cdot q along the vectors n and nb. It corresponds to \((p \cdot q)_{\perp}\).
Overview, Pair, FVLND, FVLPD, FVLRD, SPLPD, SPLND, MTLPD, MTLND, MTLRD.

StandardForm[SPLRD[p, q, n, nb] // FCI] (*Pair[LightConePerpendicularComponent[Momentum[p, D], Momentum[n, D], Momentum[nb, D]], LightConePerpendicularComponent[Momentum[q, D], Momentum[n, D], Momentum[nb, D]]]*)
SPLRD[p1 + p2, q1 + q2, n, nb] // FCI // ExpandScalarProduct
SPLRD[p1 + p2 + n, q, n, nb] // FCI // ExpandScalarProduct
